description: ~70M-param SMALL variant of exp010 (learned-hyperplane LUT-GPT). Backbone dim 256 / 4 heads / head 64 / 6 layers / ctx 512 / vocab 32768, UNTIED embeddings. All 5 LUT sites = HyperplaneMultiHeadLUT, naps qk4/v6/out6(dropped from 7)/res6/emb6, shared tph 120, forward hard, hyperplane_init anchor_pairs (exp010 winning init). Recipe = exp010: 16000 steps, Lion lut_lr 2e-4 (tables), AdamW adam_lr 3e-4 (hyperplanes no-wd by name; unembed wd 0.1), grad clip 1.0, warmup 0.1 cosine, bf16 tables + fp32 master. A/B twin = exp015 (lut_layer_type fast, fixed anchors). Tests whether learned hyperplanes help at ~70M scale.
